scientific.integrity: The conjugacy and spectral obstruction are exact consequences of the triangular ODE. No independent audit or external certification is claimed.
limitations: The result concerns compact invariant dynamics and asymptotic tangent Lyapunov exponents, not finite-time numerical exponent estimates.
It does not classify or prove chaos in the three-dimensional base system.
The absolute-value nonlinearity is handled along compact trajectories by transverse piecewise-C1 crossings of x=0.

title: Stable-filter conjugacy fixes the \(b\)-dependence of the Zhang–Tian–Li–Wu–Cui flow
